jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
jobs.description_html:
Nimbus AI builds document understanding models for banks and insurers. As a Machine Learning Engineer Intern you will train and ship NLP models used by millions of customers.

What you will do

  • Fine-tune transformer models with PyTorch and Hugging Face
  • Build FastAPI inference services and deploy them with Docker on Google Cloud
  • Evaluate large language models and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a B.Tech, B.E. or M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, graduating in 2027
  • Strong Python programming skills
  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch
  • Understanding of machine learning fundamentals

Nice to have

  • Experience with LangChain or vector databases such as pgvector
  • Publications or research experience in NLP

This is a 6-month paid internship in Bengaluru (hybrid). Stipend: INR 60,000 per month. Apply by 31 October 2026.

jobs.title: AI Research Intern - Computer Vision
jobs.description_html:
Join Lumen Labs Research to work on efficient vision models for healthcare imaging.

Responsibilities

  • Research parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA for vision transformers
  • Run experiments on medical imaging datasets and write up results
  • Collaborate with researchers on a paper submission

Qualifications

  • Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related
  • Experience with PyTorch and computer vision
  • Strong foundations in deep learning

Preferred

  • Prior research experience or a publication in computer vision or medical imaging
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face
